info.title: Local Protocol
info.description: Local Protocol delivery API. Covers service discovery, delivery requests, quotes, and deliveries.

post.description: Submit a new delivery request. The `nonce` field provides idempotency.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from local_protocol import LocalProtocol

client = LocalProtocol()
request = client.requests.create(
    id="req_demo_123",
    nonce="nonce_demo_123",
    pickup_location={"coordinates": {"latitude": 37.7751, "longitude": -122.4193}},
    dropoff_location={"coordinates": {"latitude": 37.7875, "longitude": -122.4073}},
    pickup_time="2026-02-10T17:00:00Z",
    dropoff_time="2026-02-10T17:30:00Z",
)

print(request.id)

get.description: Returns a single delivery request by ID.

post.description: Submit a quote for a delivery request. The `nonce` field provides idempotency.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from local_protocol import LocalProtocol

client = LocalProtocol()
quote = client.requests.quotes.create(
    request_id="req_demo_123",
    id="quote_demo_123",
    nonce="nonce_quote_123",
    price=1299,
    currency="USD",
    pickup_location={"coordinates": {"latitude": 37.7751, "longitude": -122.4193}},
    dropoff_location={"coordinates": {"latitude": 37.7875, "longitude": -122.4073}},
    pickup_estimate="2026-02-10T17:08:00Z",
    dropoff_estimate="2026-02-10T17:30:00Z",
    payment={
        "instruments": [
            {
                "id": "pi_demo_123",
                "handler_id": "com.localprotocol.evm_auth_capture_escrow",
                "type": "evm_auth_capture_escrow",
            }
        ]
    },
)

print(quote.id)

get.description: Returns all quotes for a delivery request.
Returns a single quote by ID.

post.description: Create a delivery from an accepted quote. The `nonce` field provides idempotency.

x-codeSamples.label: TypeScript SDK
Python SDK
x-codeSamples.source:
from local_protocol import LocalProtocol

client = LocalProtocol()
delivery = client.deliveries.create(
    request_id="req_demo_123",
    quote_id="quote_demo_123",
    nonce="nonce_delivery_123",
    event_vocabulary="xyz.localprotocol.delivery.courier@2026-01-30",
)

print(delivery.id)

EventVocabularyName.description: Event vocabulary name in reverse-domain notation (e.g., xyz.localprotocol.delivery.courier).

extended_address.description: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

address_locality.description: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

address_region.description: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. Required for applicable countries (i.e. state in US, province in CA). For example, California or another appropriate first-level Administrative division.

address_country.description: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

first_name.description: Optional. First name of the contact associated with the address.

last_name.description: Optional. Last name of the contact associated with the address.

phone_number.description: Optional. Phone number of the contact associated with the address.

pickup_instructions.description: Pickup directions, access codes, or handling notes.

dropoff_instructions.description: Dropoff directions, access codes, or delivery notes.

Interval.description: A single time interval for a day of the week or a specific date.

maximum_selections.description: Maximum number of selections allowed from this group.

items.description: Ordered list of items in this category.

availability.description: Catalog availability. When present, it overrides category and item availability.

PaymentCredential.description: The base definition for any payment credential. Handlers define specific credential types.

type.description: The credential type discriminator. Specific schemas will constrain this to a constant value.

PaymentInstrument.description: The base definition for any payment instrument. It links the instrument to a specific payment handler.

id.description: A unique identifier for this instrument instance, assigned by the platform.

handler_id.description: The unique identifier for the handler instance that produced this instrument. This corresponds to the 'id' field in the Payment Handler definition.

type.description: The broad category of the instrument (e.g., 'card', 'tokenized_card'). Specific schemas will constrain this to a constant value.

billing_address.description: The billing address associated with this payment method.

extended_address.description: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

address_locality.description: The locality in which the street address is, and which is in the region. For example, Mountain View.

address_region.description: The region in which the locality is, and which is in the country. Required for applicable countries (i.e. state in US, province in CA). For example, California or another appropriate first-level Administrative division.

address_country.description: The country. Recommended to be in 2-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, for example "US". For backward compatibility, a 3-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code such as "SGP" or a full country name such as "Singapore" can also be used.

first_name.description: Optional. First name of the contact associated with the address.

last_name.description: Optional. Last name of the contact associated with the address.

phone_number.description: Optional. Phone number of the contact associated with the address.

display.description: Display information for this payment instrument. Each payment instrument schema defines its specific display properties, as outlined by the payment handler.

selected.description: Whether this instrument is selected by the user.

SelectedPaymentInstrument.description: A payment instrument with selection state.

instruments.description: The payment instruments available for this payment. Each instrument is associated with a specific handler via the handler_id field. Handlers can extend the base payment_instrument schema to add handler-specific fields.

name.description: Standard identifier in reverse-domain notation (e.g., xyz.localprotocol.delivery.courier).

extends.description: Parent standard this standard extends (optional). Only one parent is allowed; the reference must include a version date. Used for lineage and discovery.

events.description: Map of all event IDs supported by this standard, including inherited events.

EventVocabularyName.description: Event vocabulary name in reverse-domain notation (e.g., xyz.localprotocol.delivery.courier).
